questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “According to special _____, c is the maximum speed at which all energy, matter, and physical information in the universe can travel.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “special”. It names one thing, not an action.

questions.proof: The special theory of relativity is based on the prediction, so far upheld by observations, that the measured speed of light in a vacuum is the same whether or not the source of the light and the person doing the measuring are moving relative to each other.
